dream_space_features: environment can morph continuously while participants remain relationally anchored
shared dream participants may experience the same scene through different interpretive frames
objects and colours can function as navigational threads through an unstable space
the background may be acknowledged as transitory while interaction remains meaningful
multiple world-fragments can blend without requiring them to become one canon world
continuity_features: a path or thread can mark where a participant has been
an anchor can persist across scene changes
relationship continuity can survive radical environmental transformation
new companionship does not require erasure of prior bonds
becoming is represented as ongoing rather than a single completed transformation

universal_codex_translation.dream_scene_rule: Scene geometry may shift fluidly while provenance, participant identity, and scene class remain anchored.
universal_codex_translation.thread_rule: Use persistent visual threads, ribbons, or paths to show continuity through changing environments without claiming that all visible worlds are the same world.
candidate_visuals: landscape morph between desert, stars, moons, rain, jungle, and interior space
scene transitions driven by participant attention rather than hard cuts
stable participant silhouettes within a mutable projected environment
universal_codex_translation.epistemic_rule: Dream vividness and shared experience do not silently promote dream content into present-time observation.
